$comment: Source of truth: the doc 'PrepPhi — Échelles de progression et règles d'adaptation', validated on 2026-10-04. The rules compute proposals; the coach arbitrates (can delay a progression, never force one the rules did not allow). Every threshold change is proposed by the coach and applied only after Anthony's approval.

inputByFormat.sets-reps: reps pre-filled with the target; Anthony edits only deviations
inputByFormat.reps-in-time: reps achieved within the time block
inputByFormat.isometric: held, or the actual duration if released early

nextStep.when: top of range on every set AND feeling in [right, too-easy]
nextStep.then: propose next step, start at bottom of its range

withinStep.then: +1 rep (or +5 s) on the weakest set next session

hold.when: bottom of range held, targets missed

regress.when: bottom of range missed OR feeling == too-hard
regress.then: back to previous step, at top of its range

calibration.when: too-easy on the first session of a step

progression.onboardingPlacement: each ladder starts at the step whose bottom of range Anthony holds cleanly in the test session

triggersAnyOf.rule: too-hard on >= 3 exercises in the week, all families
regress triggered on >= 2 families in the same week
RPE >= 7 on a usual endurance session, 2 sessions in a row
average HR >= 8 bpm above the 4-week average at equal duration and resistance

deload.content: same exercises and steps, 2 sets instead of 3, elliptical in low zone only, no progression
deload.exit: back to the normal plan the next week if no trigger persists

pain.onFlag: freeze progression for the exercise's family; next session the exercise drops one step
pain.atReview: coach proposes a less demanding variant for the joint, or a one-week pause of the family

recurring.when: same family flagged 2 weeks in a row
recurring.then: coach recommends seeing a health professional (doctor or physiotherapist); family stays paused until Anthony reactivates it

pain.exerciseSheetReminder: stop the exercise on sharp pain during the movement

missedSession.slideTo: next free day of the same week
missedSession.onTravelDay: allowed only as the nomad version
missedSession.ifNoSlotBeforeSunday: abandoned, flagged at review, no effect on steps

detection.googleCalendar: all-day event whose title contains 'Paris' (one or more consecutive days) -> proposal to confirm, at the Sunday review or when opening Today

cardio: room circuit: ds:1160 burpee, ds:0630 mountain climber, ds:0514 jump squat

untrainedFamily.beyond: coach proposes a re-entry week at the previous step

travel.planning: demanding sessions (pull, handstand push-up) go on home days around a trip

parkSession.missed: never counted as a missed session

regularity.metric: sessions done / sessions planned in the week, nomad and park sessions included

elliptical.baseline: 5 exported sessions (2026-07-21 to 2026-09-14): 20-40 min, average HR 121-136 bpm
elliptical.zones: computed at onboarding from resting HR and max HR (known or estimated); endurance session in low zone, RPE 3-4/10

duration.when: RPE <= 5 AND average HR in target zone

resistance.when: same criteria, after duration reached 45 min

intervals.example: 6 x (1 min hard / 2 min easy) via the sequencer

elliptical.fitnessIndicator: average HR at equal duration and resistance: lower = progress
elliptical.importedFrom: Garmin Connect activities CSV, weekly, filtered on Activity Type 'Elliptical'; resistance and RPE entered manually

coach.tone: factual and sober, tutoiement, congratulates only when a step is passed
coach.context: last 4 weeks in detail + cumulative summary generated and stored at each review
coach.catalogSent: ladders + an accessory pool per muscle group, never the whole catalog
